data.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَحْدَهُ، وَالصَّلاَةُ وَالسَّلاَمُ عَلَى مَنْ لاَ نَبِيَّ بَعْدَهُ
data.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu lillāhi waḥdahu, wāl-ṣṣaalātu wāl-ssaalāmu ʿal-ay man alā nabīīa baʿdahu
data.english: All praise is due to Allah alone, and peace and blessings be upon him after whom there is no other Prophet.
data.source: Anas (RA) said that he heard the Prophet (ﷺ) say: "That I sit with people remembering Almighty Allah from the morning (Fajr) prayer until sunrise is more beloved to me than freeing four slaves from among the Children of Isma'il. That I sit with people remembering Allah from the afternoon ('Asr) prayer, until the sun sets, is more beloved to me than freeing four slaves from among the Children of Isma'il."This was reported by Abu Dawud (No. 3667). Al-Albani graded it good in Sahih Abu Dawud 2/698.

data.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ ﴿اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاء وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ﴾.
data.transliteration: Aʿūdhu biAllāhi mina al-shhayṭāni arrajīmi (Allāhu alā ilāha īlallā huwa al-ḥayyu al-qayyuwmu alā takhudhuhu sinatun walalā nawmun llahu mā fī assamawāti wamā fī al-arḍi man dhā al-adhī yashfaʿu ʿindahu īlallā bidhnihi yaʿlamu mā bayna aydīhim wamā khal-fahum walalā yuḥīṭūna bishayʾin min ʿil-mihi īlallā bimā shāʾ wasiʿa kursīīuhu assamawāti wālarḍa walalā yūduhu ḥifẓuhumā wahūa al-ʿal-īīu al-ʿaẓīmu)
data.english: Allah! There is none worthy of worship but He, the Ever-Living, the One Who sustains and protects all that exists. Neither slumber nor sleep overtakes Him. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is he that can intercede with Him except with His Permission? He knows what happens to them in this world, and what will happen to them in the Hereafter. And they will never encompass anything of His Knowledge except that which He wills. His Throne extends over the heavens and the earth, and He feels no fatigue in guarding and preserving them. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
data.source: It was reported by Al-Hakim 1 / 562, Al-Albani graded it as authentic in Sahihut-Targhib wat-Tarhib 1/273, and traces it to An-Nasa'i and At-Tabarani. He says that At-Tabarani's chain of transmission is reliable (Jayyid).

data.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ ﴿آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلآئِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لاَ نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِ وَقَالُواْ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ* لاَ يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْساً إِلاَّ وُسْعَهَا لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ رَبَّنَا لاَ تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا رَبَّنَا وَلاَ تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْراً كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا رَبَّنَا وَلاَ تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لاَ طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَآ أَنتَ مَوْلاَنَا فَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ﴾. [البقرة 285 - 286]
data.transliteration: Aʿūdhu biAllāhi mina al-shhayṭāni arrajīmi (āmana arrasūlu bimā unzil-a īl-ayhi min rrabbihi wāl-muminūna kul-unn āmana biAllāhi wamal-āīkatihi wakutubihi warusul-ihi alā nufarriqu bayna aḥadin min rrusul-ihi waqāl-ūa samiʿnā waṭaʿnā ghufrānaka rabbanā wīl-ayka al-maṣīru* alā yukal-ifu Allāhu nafsan īlallā wusʿahā lahā mā kasabat waʿal-ayhā mā aktasabat rabbanā alā tuākhidhnā īn nnasīnā aw akhṭanā rabbanā walalā taḥmil- ʿal-aynā īṣran kamā ḥamal-tahu ʿal-ay al-adhīna min qablinā rabbanā walalā tuḥammilnā mā alā ṭāqata lanā bihi wāʿfu ʿannā wāghfir lanā wārḥamnā anta mawalānā fānṣurnā ʿal-ay al-qawmi al-kāfirīna) [al-bqra - ]
data.english: (285) The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and [so have] the believers. All of them have believed in Allah and His angels and His books and His messengers, [saying], We make no distinction between any of His messengers. And they say, We hear and we obey. [We seek] Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the [final] destination. (286) Allah does not charge a soul except [with that within] its capacity. It will have [the consequence of] what [good] it has gained, and it will bear [the consequence of] what [evil] it has earned. Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people.
data.source: It was narrated by Al-Bukhari, No. 4008, and Muslim, No. 807.

data.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ، ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ، لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ، وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ
data.transliteration: Qul- huwa llahu aḥadun, llahu l-ṣṣamadu, lam yal-id wal-am yūlad, wal-am yakun llahu kufūana aḥadun
data.english: (1) Say, He is Allah, [who is] One, (2) Allah, the Eternal Refuge.(3) He neither begets nor is born,(4) Nor is there to Him any equivalent.
data.source: The Hadith was reported by Abu Dawud 4/322, and At-Tirmidhi 5/567. See Al-Albani's Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/182.

data.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ، مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ، وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ، وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّٰثَٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ، وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
data.transliteration: Qul- aʿūdhu birabbi l-fal-aqi, min sharri mā khal-aqa, wamin sharri ghāsiqin īdhā waqaba, wamin sharri l-nnaffathati fī l-ʿuqadi, wamin sharri ḥāsidin īdhā ḥasada
data.english: (1) Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak (2) From the evil of that which He created (3) And from the evil of darkness when it settles (4) And from the evil of the blowers in knots (5) And from the evil of an envier when he envies.
data.source: The Hadith was reported by Abu Dawud 4/322, and At-Tirmidhi 5/567. See Al-Albani's Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/182.

data.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ، مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ، إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ، مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ، ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ، مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ
data.transliteration: Qul- aʿūdhu birabbi l-nnāsi, mal-iki l-nnāsi, īlillāhi l-nnāsi, min sharri l-waswāsi l-khannāsi, l-adhiy yūaswisu fī ṣudūri l-nnāsi, mina l-jinnati wannāsi
data.english: (1) Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind (2) The Sovereign of mankind (3) The God of mankind (4) From the evil of the retreating whisperer (5) Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind (6) From among the jinn and mankind.
data.source: The Hadith was reported by Abu Dawud 4/322, and At-Tirmidhi 5/567. See Al-Albani's Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/182.

data.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْملْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْملْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
data.transliteration: Aṣbaḥnā waṣbaḥa al-mlku lillāhi, wāl-ḥamdu lillāhi, alā ilāha ilallā Allāhu waḥdahu alā sharīka lahu, lahu al-mlku wal-ahu al-ḥamdu wahūa ʿal-ay kul-i shayʾin qadīrun, rabbi aal-uka khayra mā fī hadhā al-yawmi wakhayra mā baʿdahu, waʿūdhu bika min sharri mā fī hadhā al-yawmi washarri mā baʿdahu, rabbi aʿūdhu bika mina al-kasal-i wasūʾi al-kibari, rabbi aʿūdhu bika min ʿadhābin fī annāri waʿadhābin fī al-qabri
data.english: We have reached the morning and at this very time unto Allah belongs all sovereignty, and all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this day and the good of what follows it and I take refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil of what follows it. My Lord, I take refuge in You from laziness and senility. My Lord, I take refuge in You from torment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.

data.arabic: أمسينا وأمسى الملك للَّه، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رب أسألك خير ما في هذه الليلة، وخير ما بعدها، وأعوذ بك من شر ما في هذه الليلة، وشر ما بعدها، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
data.transliteration: Amsyna wamsy al-mlk llah, wāl-ḥamdu lillāhi, alā ilāha ilallā Allāhu waḥdahu alā sharīka lahu, lahu al-mul-ku wal-ahu al-ḥamdu wahūa ʿal-ay kul-i shayʾin qadīrun, rb asal-k khyr ma fy hdhh allylt, wkhyr ma bʿdha, waʿwdh bk mn shr ma fy hdhh allylt, wshr ma bʿdha, rabbi aʿūdhu bika mina al-kasal-i wasūʾi al-kibari, rabbi aʿūdhu bika min ʿadhābin fī annāri waʿadhābin fī al-qabri
data.english: We have reached the evening and at this very time unto Allah belongs all sovereignty, and all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this night and the good of what follows it and I take refuge in You from the evil of this night and the evil of what follows it. My Lord, I take refuge in You from laziness and senility. My Lord, I take refuge in You from torment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.

data.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
data.transliteration: Allāhumma bika aṣbaḥnā, wabika amsaynā, wabika naḥyā, wabika namūtu wīl-ayka annushūru
data.english: O Allah, by Your leave we have reached the morning and by Your leave we have reached the evening, by Your leave we live and die and unto You is our resurrection
data.source: Al-Tirmidhi, 5/466, No. 3391, and see: Sahih Al-Tirmidhi 3/142

data.arabic: اللَّهمَّ بِكَ أمسَينا وبِكَ أصبَحنا وبِكَ نَحيا وبِكَ نموتُ، وإليكَ المصيرُ
data.transliteration: Allāhmma bika amsayna wbika aṣbaḥna wbika naḥya wbika nmwtu, wil-yka al-mṣyru
data.english: O Allah, by Your leave we have reached the evening and by Your leave we have reached the morning, by Your leave we live and die and unto You is our return.
data.source: Al-Tirmidhi, 5/466, No. 3391, and see: Sahih Al-Tirmidhi 3/142

data.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
data.transliteration: Allāhumma anta rabbiy lā ilāha īlallā anta, khal-aqtanī wanā ʿabduka, wanā ʿal-ay ʿahdika wawaʿdika mā astaṭaʿtu, aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā ṣanaʿtu, abūʾu laka biniʿmatika ʿal-ayya, wabūʾu bidhanbī fāghfir lī fīnnahu alā yaghfiru al-dhhunwba īlallā anta
data.english: O Allah, You are my Lord, none has the right to be worshipped except You, You created me and I am Your servant and I abide to Your covenant and promise as best I can, I take refuge in You from the evil of which I have committed.  I acknowledge Your favour upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for verily none can forgive sin except You.
data.source: Narrated by Al-Bukhari, 7/150, No. 6306

data.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَصْبَحْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ، وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمَلاَئِكَتَكَ، وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ، أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ
data.transliteration: Allāhumma īnniy aṣbaḥtu ushhiduka, wushhidu ḥamal-ata ʿarshika, wamalalīkataka, wajamīʿa khal-qika, annaka anta Allāhu lā ilāha īlallā anta waḥdaka alā sharīka laka, wanna muḥammadan ʿabduka warasūluka
data.english: O Allah, verily I have reached the morning and call on You, the bearers of Your throne, Your angels, and all of Your creation to witness that You are Allah, none has the right to be worshipped except You, alone, without partner, and that Muhammad is Your Servant and Messenger.
data.source: It was narrated by Abu Dawood, 4/317, No. 5069, and by Al-Bukhari in Al-Adab Al-Mufrad, No. 1201, and by Al-Nasa'i in 'Amal Al-Yawm wal-Laylah, No. 9, and by Ibn Al-Sunni, No. 70. Sheikh Ibn Baz classified the isnad of Al-Nasa'i and Abu Dawood as hasan in Tuhfat Al-Akhyar, p. 23.

data.arabic: اللَّهم إني أمسيت أُشْهِدُكَ، وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمَلاَئِكَتَكَ، وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ، أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ
data.transliteration: Allāhm iny amsyt ushhiduka, wushhidu ḥamal-ata ʿarshika, wamalalīkataka, wajamīʿa khal-qika, annaka anta Allāhu lā ilāha īlallā anta waḥdaka alā sharīka laka, wanna muḥammadan ʿabduka warasūluka
data.english: O Allah, verily I have reached the evening and call on You, the bearers of Your throne, Your angels, and all of Your creation to witness that You are Allah, none has the right to be worshipped except You, alone, without partner, and that Muhammad is Your Servant and Messenger.
data.source: It was narrated by Abu Dawood, 4/317, No. 5069, and by Al-Bukhari in Al-Adab Al-Mufrad, No. 1201, and by Al-Nasa'i in 'Amal Al-Yawm wal-Laylah, No. 9, and by Ibn Al-Sunni, No. 70. Sheikh Ibn Baz classified the isnad of Al-Nasa'i and Abu Dawood as hasan in Tuhfat Al-Akhyar, p. 23.

data.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَصْبَحَ بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ
data.transliteration: Allāhumma mā aṣbaḥa bī min niʿmatin aw biaḥadin min khal-qika faminka waḥdaka alā sharīka laka, fal-aka al-ḥamdu wal-aka al-shhukru
data.english: O Allah, what blessing I or any of Your creation have risen upon is from You alone, without partner. So for You is all praise and unto You all thanks.
data.source: It was narrated by Abu Dawood, 4/318, No. 5073, and by Al-Nasa'i in 'Amal Al-Yawm wal-Laylah, No. 7, and by Ibn Al-Sunni, No. 41, and by Ibn Hibban in Mawarid, No. 2361. Sheikh Ibn Baz classified the isnad as hasan in Tuhfat Al-Akhyar, p. 24.

data.arabic: اللَّهم ما أمسى بي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ
data.transliteration: Allāhm ma amsy by min niʿmatin aw biaḥadin min khal-qika faminka waḥdaka alā sharīka laka, fal-aka al-ḥamdu wal-aka al-shhukru
data.english: O Allah, what blessing I or any of Your creation have reached the evening upon is from You alone, without partner. So for You is all praise and unto You all thanks
data.source: It was narrated by Abu Dawood, 4/318, No. 5073, and by Al-Nasa'i in 'Amal Al-Yawm wal-Laylah, No. 7, and by Ibn Al-Sunni, No. 41, and by Ibn Hibban in Mawarid, No. 2361. Sheikh Ibn Baz classified the isnad as hasan in Tuhfat Al-Akhyar, p. 24.

data.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ، وَالفَقْرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ القَبْرِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
data.transliteration: Allāhumma ʿāfinī fī badanī, Allāhumma ʿāfinī fī samʿī, Allāhumma ʿāfinī fī baṣarī, alā ilāha īlallā anta Allāhumma īnniy aʿūdhu bika mina al-kufri, wāl-faqri, waʿūdhu bika min ʿadhābi al-qabri, alā ilāha īlallā anta
data.english: (O Allah, grant my body health, O Allah, grant my hearing health, O Allah, grant my sight health.  None has the right to be worshipped except You.) (O Allah, I take refuge with You from disbelief and poverty, and I take refuge with You from the punishment of the grave.  None has the right to be worshipped except You.)
data.source: Abu Dawud 4/324, Ahmad 5/42, An-Nasa'i, 'Amalul-Yawm wal-Laylah (No. 22), Ibn As-Sunni (No. 69), Al-Bukhari Al-'Adab Al-Mufrad. Its chain of transmission is good (Hasan), Ibn Baz, p. 26.

data.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ عَلَيهِ تَوَكَّلتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
data.transliteration: ḥasbīa Allāhu alā ilāha īlallā huwa ʿal-ayhi tawakkaltu wahūa rabbu al-ʿarshi al-ʿaẓīmi
data.english: Allah is Sufficient for me, none has the right to be worshipped except Him, upon Him I rely and He is Lord of the exalted throne.
data.source: It was narrated by Ibn As-Sunni, No. 71, attributed directly to the Prophet (Marfu'), and by Abu Dawud as a statement of a Companion (Mawquf), 4/321, No. 5081. The chain of transmission was authenticated by Shu'ayb and 'Abd al-Qadir al-Arna'ut. See: Zad Al-Ma'ad 2/376.

data.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ: فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي، وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي، وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَينِ يَدَيَّ، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
data.transliteration: Allāhumma īnniy aal-uka al-ʿafwa wāl-ʿāfīata fī addunyā wāl-ākhirati, Allāhumma īnniy aal-uka al-ʿafwa wāl-ʿāfīata: fī dīnī wadunyāya wahlī, wamāl-ī, Allāhumma astur ʿawrātī, wāmin rawʿātī, Allāhumma aḥfaẓnī min bayni yadayya, wamin khal-fī, waʿan yamīnī, waʿan shimāl-ī, wamin fawqī, waʿūdhu biʿaẓamatika an ughtāl-a min taḥtī
data.english: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this life and the next. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religious and worldly affairs, and my family and my wealth. O Allah, veil my weaknesses and set at ease my dismay. O Allah, preserve me from the front and from behind and on my right and on my left and from above, and I take refuge with You lest I be swallowed up by the earth.
data.source: Abu Dawood, No. 5074, and Ibn Majah, No. 3871. See: Sahih Ibn Majah, 2/332.

data.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطانِ وَشَرَكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءاً، أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ
data.transliteration: Allāhumma ʿāl-ima al-ghaybi wāl-shhahādati fāṭira assamawāti wālarḍi, rabba kul-i shayʾin wamal-īkahu, ashhadu an alā ilāha īlallā anta, aʿūdhu bika min sharri nafsī, wamin sharri al-shhayṭani washarakihi, wan aqtarifa ʿal-ay nafsī sūʾan, aw ajurrahu īl-ay muslimin
data.english: (O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Creator of the heavens and the Earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things, I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except You. I take refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil and shirk of the devil, and from committing wrong against my soul or bringing such upon another Muslim.)(shirk: to associate others with Allah in those things which are specific to Him.  This can occur in (1) belief, e.g. to believe that other than Allah has the power to benefit or harm, (2) speech, e.g. to swear by other than Allah and (3) action, e.g. to bow or prostrate to other than Allah.)
data.source: Al-Tirmidhi, No. 3392, and Abu Dawood, No. 5067. See: Sahih Al-Tirmidhi, 3/142.

data.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لاَ يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلاَ فِي السّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
data.transliteration: Bismi Allāhi al-adhī alā yaḍurru maʿa asmihi shayʾun fī alarḍi walalā fī assmāʾi wahūa assamīʿu al-ʿal-īmu
data.english: In the name of Allah with whose name nothing is harmed on earth nor in the heavens and He is The All-Seeing, The All-Knowing.
data.source: It was narrated by Abu Dawood, 4/323, No. 5088, Al-Tirmidhi, 5/465, No. 3388, Ibn Majah, No. 3869, and Ahmad, No. 446. See: Sahih Ibn Majah, 2/332. Sheikh Ibn Baz classified the isnad as hasan in Tuhfat Al-Akhyar, p. 39.

data.arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبَّاً، وَبِالْإِسْلاَمِ دِيناً، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَبِيًّا
data.transliteration: Raḍītu biAllāhi rabban, wabial-īsalāmi dīnan, wabimuḥammadin ṣly allh ʿlyh wslm nabīanā
data.english: I am pleased with Allah as a Lord, and Islam as a religion and Muhammad  as a Prophet.
data.source: Ahmad, 4/337, No. 18967, Al-Nasa'i in 'Amal Al-Yawm wal-Laylah, No. 4, Ibn Al-Sunni, No. 68, Abu Dawood, 4/318, No. 1531, and Al-Tirmidhi, 5/465, No. 3389. Sheikh Ibn Baz classified it as hasan in Tuhfat Al-Akhyar, p. 39.

data.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغيثُ أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِيَ كُلَّهُ وَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
data.transliteration: Yā ḥayyu yā qayyuwmu biraḥmatika astaghythu aṣliḥ lī shanīa kul-ahu walalā takil-nī īl-ay nafsī ṭarfata ʿaynin
data.english: O Ever Living, O Self-Subsisting and Supporter of all, by Your mercy I seek assistance, rectify for me all of my affairs and do not leave me to myself, even for the blink of an eye.
data.source: Its chain of transmission is sound (Sahih), Al-Hakim 1/545, see Albani, Sahihut-Targhib wat-Tarhib, 1/273.

data.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ: فَتْحَهُ، وَنَصْرَهُ، وَنورَهُ، وَبَرَكَتَهُ، وَهُدَاهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِيهِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ
data.transliteration: Aṣbaḥnā waṣbaḥa al-mul-ku lillāhi rabbi al-ʿāl-amīna, Allāhumma īnniy aal-uka khayra hadhā al-yawmi: fatḥahu, wanaṣrahu, wanwrahu, wabarakatahu, wahudāhu, waʿūdhu bika min sharri mā fīhi washarri mā baʿdahu
data.english: We have reached the morning and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of this day, its triumphs and its victories, its light and its blessings and its guidance, and I take refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil that follows it.
data.source: Abu Dawud 4/322. Its transmission chain is good (Hasan). See also Ibn Al-Qayyim, Zadul- Ma'ad 2/273.

data.arabic: أَمْسَيْنا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ للهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمَيْنِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّي أسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَه اللَّيْلَةِ فَتْحَهَا ونَصْرَهَا، ونُوْرَهَا وبَرَكَتهَا، وَهُدَاهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فيهِا وَشَرَّ مَا بَعْدَهَا
data.transliteration: Amsayna wamsay al-mul-ku llhi rabbi al-ʿāl-amayni, Allāhumma īnnay aal-uka khayra hadhah allaylati fatḥahā wnaṣrahā, wnūrahā wbarakathā, wahudāhā, waʿūdhu bika min sharri mā fyhia washarra mā baʿdahā
data.english: We have reached the evening and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of tonight, its triumphs and its victories, its light and its blessings and its guidance, and I take refuge in You from the evil of tonight and the evil that follows it.
data.source: Abu Dawud 4/322. Its transmission chain is good (Hasan). See also Ibn Al-Qayyim, Zadul- Ma'ad 2/273.

data.arabic: أَصْبَحْنا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلاَمِ، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلاَصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَنِيفاً مُسْلِماً وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشرِكِينَ
data.transliteration: Aṣbaḥna ʿal-ay fiṭrati al-īsalāmi, waʿal-ay kal-imati al-īkhalāṣi, waʿal-ay dīni nabīīinā muḥammadin ṣly allh ʿlyh wslm, waʿal-ay mil-ati abīnā ībrāhīma, ḥanīfan musliman wamā kāna mina al-mushrikīna
data.english: We rise upon the fitrah of Islam, and the word of pure faith, and upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, and the religion of our forefather Ibraheem, who was a Muslim and of true faith and was not of those who associate others with Allah.
data.source: Ahmad, 3/406 and 407, nos. 15360 and 15563, and Ibn Al-Sunni in 'Amal Al-Yawm wal-Laylah, No. 34. See: Sahih Al-Jami', 4/209.

data.arabic: أمسينا على فطرة الإسلام، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلاَصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَنِيفاً مُسْلِماً وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشرِكِينَ
data.transliteration: Amsyna ʿly fṭra al-isal-m, waʿal-ay kal-imati al-īkhalāṣi, waʿal-ay dīni nabīīinā muḥammadin ṣly allh ʿlyh wslm, waʿal-ay mil-ati abīnā ībrāhīma, ḥanīfan musliman wamā kāna mina al-mushrikīna
data.english: We have entered the evening upon the fitrah of Islam, and the word of pure faith, and upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, and the religion of our forefather Ibraheem, who was a Muslim and of true faith and was not of those who associate others with Allah.
data.source: Ahmad, 3/406 and 407, nos. 15360 and 15563, and Ibn Al-Sunni in 'Amal Al-Yawm wal-Laylah, No. 34. See: Sahih Al-Jami', 4/209.

data.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْماً نَافِعاً، وَرِزْقاً طَيِّباً، وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً
data.transliteration: Allāhumma īnniy aal-uka ʿil-man nāfiʿan, warizqan ṭayyiban, waʿamalalan mutaqabbaalan
data.english: O Allah, I ask You for knowledge which is beneficial and sustenance which is good, and deeds which are acceptable.
data.source: It was narrated by Ibn Al-Sunni in 'Amal Al-Yawm wal-Laylah, No. 54, and by Ibn Majah, No. 925. The chain of transmission was classified as hasan by 'Abd al-Qadir and Shu'ayb al-Arna'ut in their verification of Zad Al-Ma'ad, 2/375.

data.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
data.transliteration: Alā ilāha īlallā Allāhu, waḥdahu alā sharīka lahu, lahu al-mul-ku wal-ahu al-ḥamdu wahūa ʿal-ay kul-i shayʾin qadīrun
data.english: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent.
data.source: Sahih Al-Bukhari: 6404, Sahih Muslim: 2693, Al-Nasa'i in 'Amal Al-Yawm wal-Laylah, No. 24. See: Sahih Al-Targhib wal-Tarhib, 1/272, Tuhfat Al-Akhyar by Ibn Baz, p. 44, and its virtue in: p. 146, hadith No. 255. Once when feeling lazy: Abu Dawood, No. 5077, Ibn Majah, No. 3798, Ahmad, No. 8719. See: Sahih Al-Targhib wal-Tarhib, 1/270, Sahih Abi Dawood, 3/957, Sahih Ibn Majah, 2/331, and Zad Al-Ma'ad, 2/377.

data.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى نَبَيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
data.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣal-i wasal-im ʿal-ay nabayyinā muḥammadin
data.english: O Allaah, send prayers and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad.
data.source: It was narrated by Al-Tabarani with two isnads, one of which is good. See: Majma' Al-Zawa'id, 10/120, and Sahih Al-Targhib wal-Tarhib, 1/273 [No. 656], and Da'if Al-Targhib wal-Tarhib, No. 396, and in Al-Silsilah Al-Da'ifah, No. 5788.

data.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
data.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bikal-imāti Allāhi attāmmāti min sharri mā khal-aqa
data.english: I take refuge in Allah’s perfect words from the evil He has created.
data.source: Ahmad 2/ 290, An-Nasa'i, 'Amalul-Yawm wal-Laylah No. 590, At-Tirmidhi 3/187, Ibn As-Sunni No. 68. According to Al-Albani, Ibn Majah's (2/266) chain of transmission is sound (Sahih), and following Ibn Baz 45, At-Tirmidhi's report is good (Hasan).

data.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ: عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
data.transliteration: Subḥāna Allāhi wabiḥamdihi: ʿadada khal-qihi, wariḍā nafsihi, wazinata ʿarshihi, wamidāda kal-imātihi
data.english: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him by the number of His creation and His pleasure, and by the weight of His throne, and the ink of His words.
data.source: Muslim 4/2090, No. 2726

data.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
data.transliteration: Alā ilāha īlallā Allāhu, waḥdahu alā sharīka lahu, lahu al-mul-ku wal-ahu al-ḥamdu wahūa ʿal-ay kul-i shayʾin qadīrun
data.english: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent.
data.source: Al-Bukhari, 4/95, No. 3293, and Muslim, 4/2071, No. 2691. Ten times: Al-Nasa'i in 'Amal Al-Yawm wal-Laylah, No. 24. See: Sahih Al-Targhib wal-Tarhib, 1/272, and Tuhfat Al-Akhyar by Ibn Baz, p. 44, and its virtue in: p. 146, hadith No. 255. Once when feeling lazy: Abu Dawood, No. 5077, Ibn Majah, No. 3798, Ahmad, No. 8719. See: Sahih Al-Targhib wal-Tarhib, 1/270, Sahih Abi Dawood, 3/957, Sahih Ibn Majah, 2/331, and Zad Al-Ma'ad, 2/377.

data.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
data.transliteration: Astaghfiru Allāha watūbu īl-ayhi
data.english: I seek Allaah’s forgiveness and I turn to Him in repentance.
data.source: Al-Bukhari with Al-Fath, 11/101 [No. 6307], and Muslim, 4/2075 [No. 2702].

data.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
data.transliteration: Subḥāna Allāhi wabiḥamdihi
data.english: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him.
data.source: Muslim 2692
